about.title: About LogiSim
about.lede: A teaching logistics system where customers, drivers, warehouse, CS, and admins collaborate on the same platform.
about.purpose.title: Purpose
about.purpose.body: Use a virtual four-ring map to simulate pickup, sorting, transfer, delivery, and billing so learners see how logistics works end-to-end.
about.roles.title: Roles
about.roles.body: Customers, drivers, warehouse staff, customer service, and admins each have their own workspace and only see the tasks they need.
about.learning.title: Learning Focus
about.learning.body: Order lifecycle, event logging, regional fleets, billing models (prepaid / COD / monthly), and lightweight service rule settings.
